sn47.10:2.4: The sense of _pubbenāpara_ as “than they had before” (literally, “after than before”) is established at [dn26:9.6](), where subjects do not prosper as they had before under a righteous king.
sn47.10:6.3: It’s difficult to get around “fever” here for parilaha, obviously it’s not talking about illness.
sn47.10:8.3: See note on AN 7.61 for pacchapure.
